Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might…

people.name: Apollos
people.line: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
translations.bsb: For when one of you says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” are you not mere men?
translations.kjv: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
translations.asv: For when one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not men?
